title: Continued Fractions of Polynomial Type: Theory and Encyclopedic Dictionary
summary: After giving a number of properties of continued fractions of polynomial type, in particular focusing on convergence properties and Bauer-Muir-Apéry acceleration techniques, we give a large list of continued fractions, both for specific real numbers, and for special functions, some extracted from a number of different sources, but most others being probably new.
